geometry_proof.scope: Root reviewed the independent final raw structure/finite summaries and actual final decoder with all four current roles: raw, web, authored_lod and lod, each passing the same 2266 finite questions. Web retains the oriented position/material triangle multiset; normal deviation is at most 0.0280682 degrees within the fixed 0.05-degree tolerance. The authored LOD removes only 13361 thin mortar-seam groups and preserves all 7379 remaining groups/259544 triangles; web has 419884 triangles. Actual decoded bounds differences are zero. These results and the all-part aperture projection prove the stated finite geometry scope, not complete collision or measured architectural accuracy.

height_evidence.scope: The SIADR project description gives nominal total height 27.7m and six above-ground floors. The actual grounded raw and decoded geometry spans z=0 to 27.700000762939453m. This is a project reference value rather than an independent measurement. Five main storeys with a setback sixth are modeled, with the removed seventh omitted. Floor spacing, canopies and local construction dimensions remain estimates.

identity_footprint.scope: Root accepts the complete adjoining Sihang and Continental Bank warehouse compound as one frozen OSM/Overture source owner, local 650. The five neighbors 155, 509, 1640, 2379 and 2743 remain independent. The manually traced plan uses its 20m scale and rigid registration; RMS 2.463882m and Hausdorff 3.573513m express plan/map disagreement, not survey precision. Model outline is not stretched to the source replacement boundary.

roof.scope: Final actual native views and geometry reports show the setback sixth floor, fifth-floor west-entry crown, parapets, two framed glazed atrium roof areas, lower canopies and east pitched upper canopy. The latter has a verified finite geometry connection through its actual parapet supports. Roof service shapes, exact glass pane subdivision and unseen rear detail are estimated; geometric contact is not a structural-engineering certification.

size_proof.scope: Root checked the actual package and decoder asset descriptors: raw 25721072B, web 9109892B, LOD 5513608B, native 12868230B. All are strictly below the user limit of 100000000B. The LOD exceeds an internal 5MB aspiration but retains protected facade and damage details; that aspiration does not override the user limit.

source_photos.scope: Root reviewed the source register, individual CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA attributions and exact public whitelist. Nine licensed files represent eight independent photographs plus a 1920px variant. The author records viewing all nine; root actually viewed the four Commons and six designer images listed in ROOT_REFERENCE_REVIEW, and additionally Commons 83213119, 65213484, 195996200, 195996201 and the 148812398-1920 view during revision. This is reference-based exterior interpretation. None of the photographs are model textures; private designer-image pixels are excluded from publication.

texture_mapping_qa.scope: Actual package and final production Three/Meshopt decoding contain zero embedded image textures and preserve the loaded material properties. The authored geometry has no photographic UV mapping; windows and damage depths are modeled surfaces. No private photograph or diagram pixels are published. This review accepts consistent geometric/material export, not photogrammetric or physically measured material appearance.

uncertainty.scope: Accepted as a photo/plan-informed restored exterior. Plan/map alignment, hidden north details, small dimensions, glazing finish, weathering, roof services, inscription typeface and damage depths retain explicit uncertainty. Only 65 selected small marks are reconstructed. The actual navigation proof concerns one exterior body/camera start and three rays, not surveyed ground or all routes. Browser visual appearance, source masking, catalog lifecycle and real keyboard movement remain separate pending work.

visible_facade_opening_grid.scope: Root viewed final native full/detail/rear images and checked the final independent architecture report against the reviewed sources. The two south elevations retain 10 and 8 ordinary bays, separate deep entrances, 376 glazed openings, east-end three-column arrangement and curved north. West damage has seven glass-backed openings, one brick-backed deep recess and 65 selected small pits. V6 removes the false foreground floor strips at H1-H5. Actual all-part triangle clipping reports zero projected obstruction inside seven openings with a 25mm silhouette-edge exclusion. It does not establish every historical hole or every sightline.
